description: Hermes Agent through the vendor's PowerShell installer, found by the launchers it writes, installed and running.
why: The vendor's native Windows route puts the whole install under %LOCALAPPDATA%\hermes. The file row is the installed witness, read by filesystem-windows.sql's per-user launcher branch, and the proc row is the running one. require_rows holds each witness separately, so the scenario cannot pass on one route while the other is broken. Nothing is forbidden: no file this install writes is a catalogued agent's lookalike.
known_gaps: Running is witnessed by the launcher only. The gateway's Python child, under %LOCALAPPDATA%\hermes\tools\, is matched by nothing, so a gateway started without a launcher in bin\ reads as installed and not running.
The installer's MSIX desktop stage (-IncludeDesktop) is not run; 108-windows-hermes-desktop installs the packaged desktop app instead.
